exercises.why: **заглядывал** — загля́дывать (imperfective): to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); (colloquial) to drop in (on), to look in (on), to call (on). Wiktionary: заглянуть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **оглядывал** — огля́дывать (imperfective): to examine, to inspect, to look over. Wiktionary: огляде́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Выгляни** — вы́глянуть (perfective): to look out, to peep out; to appear, to emerge, to come into view. Wiktionary: вы́- + -гляну́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to cast a glance (from time to time)
to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at)
to examine, to inspect, to look over
to look out, to peep out
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: погля́дывать — to cast a glance (from time to time); загля́дывать — to glance (at), to peep (in), to look (into), to have a look (at); огля́дывать — to examine, to inspect, to look over; вы́глянуть — to look out, to peep out.
**выглянул** — вы́глянуть (perfective): to look out, to peep out; to appear, to emerge, to come into view. Wiktionary: вы́- + -гляну́ть.

to examine, to inspect, to look over
to look, to appear, to seem
to make out, to discern, to descry
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: взгля́дывать — to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance; огляде́ть — to examine, to inspect, to look over; вы́глядеть — to look, to appear, to seem; разгляде́ть — to make out, to discern, to descry.
**переглянулись** — перегляну́ться (perfective): to exchange glances, to look at each other. Wiktionary: пере- + -гляну́ть + -ся.
